steps.text: Linda typed her address on a website. She wants to know her home's value. Now you call her. What do you say?

steps.h: What every seller wants to know

cards.back: The agent answers this. Never you.

cards.front: How much money do I keep?
cards.back: This is called the net. The agent shows it.

steps.text: You never give a home value.
steps.sub: Only the agent can. A guess hurts everyone.

items.text: Daniel will show you real numbers.
Can I ask why you are selling?

steps.text: A listing consultation is a meeting. The agent visits the home. The agent shows the seller a real price. Your job is to book it.

steps.q: What is your goal on a seller call?
options: Book a meeting with the agent
steps.why: You book the listing consultation. The agent does the rest.

steps.h: Seller A.L.M. Same letters. Tap each one

cards.back: Appointment: the agent visits the home.
Location: the home's address and a few facts.
Motivation: why they are selling, and by when.

steps.line: Hi Linda, this is Ana with Rivera Home Team. This call may be recorded. You asked about 418 Maple Court, right?

steps.h: Put the seller call in order
items: Say your name and the address
Ask when they want to move
Offer two times with the agent

steps.before: Can I ask what has you thinking about

steps.says: My husband got a job in Phoenix.

options.text: Great! Your home will sell fast.
options.why: You cannot promise that. Ask a question.

options.text: That is great news! When do you need to move?
options.why: Kind, and you learn her timeline.

options.text: How much do you owe on the home?
options.why: Money questions belong to the agent.

steps.sub: Ask why they are selling. Then ask when.

steps.says: Just give me a number. What is it worth?

options.text: I am an assistant. I cannot give values. Daniel can, at your home.
options.why: Honest and clear. Next, offer two times.
A range is still a value. Never guess.

steps.says: A website says my home is worth $520,000.

options.why: Never say bad things about the websites.

options.text: Good starting point. A website cannot see inside your home.
options.why: True and kind. Now offer the agent's visit.

steps.line: Daniel can visit your home and show you real numbers. Would Tuesday at 5 or Thursday at 6 work?

steps.q: Linda and her husband both own the home. Who should be at the meeting?
steps.why: Everyone who decides should be there.

steps.text: Sellers say "not now" too. Use the same three steps. Acknowledge, ask, appointment.

steps.says: We just want to see what we could get.

options.text: OK. Call us when you are ready.
options.why: You gave up. Always offer a time.

options.text: Smart. Daniel can show you real numbers. Tuesday at 5 or Thursday at 6?
options.why: You agree first. Then you ask for the meeting.

steps.says: We are not selling for six months.

options.text: Thank you. Many sellers meet the agent early. When should I check back?
options.why: You respect her date and plan a call back.

options.text: Six months is too late. Sell now.
It is about the same everywhere.
Great question for your agent. Daniel will explain it when you meet.

steps.text: Later is a date, not a no.
steps.sub: Set a task. Call back when you said.

items.text: When do you want to move?

steps.q: A buyer says: "We must sell our house first." What is this?
options: A reason to end the call
steps.why: You found a seller. Log both needs. Tell your agent.

steps.text: Nice work! You can now handle a seller call and book the meeting.

quiz.q: A seller asks: "What is my home worth?" What do you do?
options: Say the agent will show real numbers
quiz.explain: You never give a value. The agent does.

quiz.q: What is the goal of a seller call?
quiz.explain: You book the meeting. The agent does the rest.

quiz.q: In seller A.L.M., what is L?
quiz.explain: L is Location. For a seller, it is their home.

quiz.q: A seller says: "Not for six months." What do you do?
options: Set a task and check back
quiz.explain: Later is a date, not a no.

quiz.q: A seller asks about commission. What do you say?
options: Great question for your agent. Daniel will explain it.
